value.description: Text to copy to the clipboard.

html.description: Optional HTML representation written alongside text/plain through ClipboardItem.

confirmDuration.description: Duration in ms to show the confirmation state. Default 1500.

label.description: Accessible label for the idle state. Defaults to "Copy to clipboard".

copiedLabel.description:
Accessible label for the copied state — what `aria-live="polite"` announces
when the copy succeeds. Defaults to "Copied". Override this when `label` is
customized so the live-region announcement reflects what just happened
(e.g. label="Copy code" + copiedLabel="Code copied").

iconOnly.description:
Render the button with only an icon and a visually hidden label.
When true, defaults to a Copy icon (idle) and a Check icon (copied).

unsupportedProps.name: confirmation
unsupportedProps.description: Content rendered while in the "copied" state.

unsupportedProps.name: image
unsupportedProps.description: Optional image blob or URL written alongside text and HTML when supported.

unsupportedProps.name: onError
unsupportedProps.description: Called when the clipboard write fails (permission denied, insecure context, or the legacy execCommand fallback also failing).
